北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴朗风大，注意防晒，穿衣别太少哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and windy in Beijing today, remember sunscreen and don't dress too lightly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温适中。记得带伞，以防小雨哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with moderate temps. Bring an umbrella, just in case!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云体感热，湿度高，注意补水，保持清爽。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels warm with high humidity. Stay hydrated and cool!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州酷热，体感 37℃。多饮水，做好防暑降温哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is scorching, feels like 37℃. Drink water and stay cool!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗炎热，湿度较高。出门做好防晒，多喝水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot with high humidity. Sunscreen up and drink plenty of water.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，风力 4级，体感舒适。外出注意防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with a 4-level wind, feels pleasant. Watch out for wind outdoors.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗炎热，注意防晒防暑，多补充水分！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and hot. Remember sunscreen, prevent heatstroke, and hydrate!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感凉爽。记得带件薄外套，以防着凉。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels cool. Bring a light jacket to avoid catching a cold.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，能见度低。驾车请减速慢行，注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and safely.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 22℃，体感凉爽。外出记得添衣哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and cool at 22℃. Remember to layer up when going out.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天湿润，体感凉爽。注意保暖，出门带伞。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and humid, feels cool. Stay warm and bring an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，风力 4级，体感微凉。注意保暖防风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with a 4-level wind, feels slightly cool. Stay warm and shield from wind.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云风力 5级，体感凉。风大，注意添衣保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy with a 5-level wind, feels cool. It's windy, remember to dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明中雨，体感寒凉。风大雨大，记得带伞多穿衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has moderate rain, feels chilly. It's windy and rainy, bring an umbrella and dress warmly.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云风力 6级，体感闷热。注意防晒，做好防风！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with a 6-level wind, feels muggy. Sunscreen up and brace for wind!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 6级

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗风力 5级，体感舒适。外出注意防风防晒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny with a 5-level wind, feels pleasant. Watch out for wind and sun outside.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，风力 6级，体感较冷。注意防风添衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny with a 6-level wind, feels quite cold. Brace for wind and layer up!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 6级
